claude_proposed_widenings.name: DiceAmount.fixed ability modifier addend
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing reduction surface can express fixed dice, linked amounts, or resource-spent amounts, but not a non-spell ability modifier added to a fixed roll. The core reduction amount cannot be authored honestly without this.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "reduce the damage by 1d10 plus your Dexterity modifier"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.free_hand
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The reaction is only available when the wearer has a free hand. Current equipment predicates cover wearing, holding, armor, wielding, and conjunctions of those, but not an empty-hand requirement.
